name: s6-bots
goal: @all Next milestone, like a player rushing bots: get construction robots working. Research lubricant, electric engines, batteries, robotics and construction robotics (queue them; every one needs blue packs, so scale chemical science), build lubricant and battery production plus assemblers for electric engines, flying robot frames and construction robots, then put up a roboport with at least 10 construction robots and a storage chest stocked with building materials. Keep the labs busy the whole time.

score.name: bot_techs
score.lua: local k=0 for _,n in pairs({'lubricant','electric-engine','battery','robotics','construction-robotics'}) do if f.technologies[n].researched then k=k+1 end end return k
score.note: lubricant, electric-engine, battery, robotics, construction-robotics researched

score.name: construction_robots
score.lua: local k=0 for _,n in pairs(f.logistic_networks['nauvis'] or {}) do k=k+n.all_construction_robots end return k
score.note: construction robots in a roboport network (in the air or docked)

score.name: techs_researched
score.lua: local k=0 for _,t in pairs(f.technologies) do if t.researched then k=k+1 end end return k

score.name: science_packs_used
score.note: lifetime packs consumed by labs; progress = value - baseline
